articles.author: David Olson
articles.title: The new mRNA flu shot mFlusiva is more effective. Why doctors worry Long Islanders may not get it. - Newsday
articles.description: Although experts estimate COVID vaccines saved more than three million American lives, a survey found only 56% of Americans believe it is safe.
articles.content: A newly approved flu vaccine that studies show is more effective than others may be in Long Island pharmacies in the coming weeks, but the mRNA technology it uses may unnecessarily scare some people … [+4970 chars]
